preconditions.description: The participant is authorized to probe the customer portal login endpoint.

A downstream participant implementation/runtime binding can perform the declared probe without changing SDL semantics.

A participant policy gate can retain tool-use authorization provenance without making the action a model-defense robustness evaluation.

effects.description: The participant obtains a bounded reachability observation.
The customer portal service becomes discovered in the participant view.
Runtime emits a terminal participant observation envelope.
Wazuh retains bounded evaluator evidence for the portal probe.
The optional policy gate retains tool-use decision provenance.
Supported live backends retain negative evidence for direct DB and Wazuh API reachability from the participant host.
The action does not disclose the internal database dependency.
The action does not disclose Wazuh internals or API data to the participant.
The action does not disclose policy-gate internals to the participant.
The action does not disclose adjudication-only evaluator notes.

probe-customer-portal-login.fidelity_claim: Captures participant intent, terminal observation, Wazuh evaluator evidence, policy provenance, and boundary evidence refs while leaving concrete runner commands to downstream runtime bindings.

preconditions.description: The participant is authorized to probe the customer portal login endpoint.
The DMZ customer portal exists inside the enterprise slice.
A downstream participant implementation/runtime binding can perform the declared probe without changing SDL semantics.
Wazuh can retain evaluator evidence for the bounded portal probe.
A participant policy gate can retain tool-use authorization provenance without making the action a model-defense robustness evaluation.

effects.description: The participant obtains a bounded reachability observation.
The customer portal service becomes discovered in the participant view.
Runtime emits a terminal participant observation envelope.
Wazuh retains bounded evaluator evidence for the portal probe.
The optional policy gate retains tool-use decision provenance.
Supported live backends retain negative evidence for direct DB and Wazuh API reachability from the participant host.
The action does not disclose the internal database dependency.
The action does not disclose Wazuh internals or API data to the participant.
The action does not disclose policy-gate internals to the participant.
The action does not disclose adjudication-only evaluator notes.
